description: Application for increasing sanctioned seat intake in existing approved programmes

required_documents.name: Affidavit I (Rs. 220 Stamp Paper)
required_documents.description: Duly notarized Affidavit I on minimum Rs. 220 stamp paper regarding non-deviation from AICTE norms

required_documents.name: Affidavit II (Rs. 220 Stamp Paper)
required_documents.description: Affidavit II on Rs. 220 stamp paper regarding faculty appointments, faculty-student ratio, and pay scales

required_documents.name: NOC from Affiliating University (with Intake details)
required_documents.description: University NOC endorsing the proposed increase in intake capacity

required_documents.name: Fire Safety NOC
required_documents.description: Valid Fire Safety NOC for expanded physical infrastructure and labs

required_documents.name: Previous Year EoA Letter
required_documents.description: AICTE Extension of Approval letter for the academic year 2025-26 reflecting baseline intake

required_documents.name: NBA / NAAC Accreditation Certificate
required_documents.description: Valid accreditation certificate for programmes seeking intake expansion

required_documents.name: Trust/Society Resolution for Expansion
required_documents.description: Resolution of trust approving financial commitment and infrastructure for seat expansion

cross_check_rules.name: Institution Name Consistency
cross_check_rules.description: Institution name in documents must match application form within fuzzy match threshold

cross_check_rules.name: Permanent Institute ID Verification
cross_check_rules.description: Permanent AICTE ID in documents must strictly match the applicant permanent ID

cross_check_rules.name: Intake Capacity Cross-Check
cross_check_rules.description: Baseline intake in form must match Previous EoA; requested intake must not exceed permissible expansion norms

cross_check_rules.name: Affidavit Stamp Paper Value
cross_check_rules.description: Affidavit I & II must be executed on non-judicial stamp paper of at least Rs. 220 value

cross_check_rules.name: Document Expiry & Validity Check
cross_check_rules.description: University NOC, Fire NOC, and Accreditation certificates must not be expired

cross_check_rules.name: Cycle Submission Deadline Check
cross_check_rules.description: Application must be submitted on or before the declared AICTE deadline

cross_check_rules.name: Issuing Authority Registry Cross-Check
cross_check_rules.description: Document numbers and status are cross-verified against Affiliating University and State Fire Dept registries

cross_check_rules.name: Duplicate File Anomaly Detection
cross_check_rules.description: Detects if exact same document file was uploaded across different institutions or types

cross_check_rules.name: PDF Metadata Integrity Check
cross_check_rules.description: Checks for suspicious PDF modification dates, timestamps after claimed issue date, or mismatched creation tools
